name: Tennis Ball Master 3D
tagline: 3D tennis with spin, slices, drop shots and smashes.
desc: 3D tennis for iPhone and iPad with drag-and-swipe controls, topspin, slice, drop shots and smashes, several court surfaces and upgradable rackets.
details: Tennis Ball Master 3D has been on the App Store since October 2025 (version 1.0). Matches are played with simple drag-and-swipe shots, and every hit lets you shape spin, speed and placement.
A larger update is in development: new game modes, a career mode and missions.
highlights: Live on the App Store (version 1.0, universal iPhone and iPad)
Grass, clay and hard court surfaces
Topspin, slice, drop shot and smash
Update with new modes and a career mode in development
alt: Tennis Ball Master 3D screens on a clay-orange background

name: BandPulse: Piano Rhythm Game
tagline: One song, every instrument.
desc: Rhythm game for iPhone and iPad: one song, every instrument (piano, guitar, drums and DJ), 12 original songs and a 60-level World Tour. Also out on HUAWEI AppGallery for Android.
alt: BandPulse: One song. Every instrument.

name: The Last Star: Into the Dark
tagline: A boy, a small light, a world gone dark.
desc: Atmospheric silhouette puzzle platformer for iPhone and iPad: thirty chapters in six acts, hounds and listeners that hunt by trail and sound, and Lumi's light to push back the dark.
alt: The Last Star: Into the Dark title screen, a boy and his glowing companion under a street lamp in the rain

name: Ludo Royale
tagline: Ludo and Snakes & Ladders on a 3D tabletop, online.
desc: Ludo and Snakes & Ladders on a 3D tabletop with online multiplayer, backed by an authoritative C# game server.
details: Ludo Royale plays both classic board games on a 3D tabletop. The game rules live in plain C# and are shared by the Unity client and the server, so online matches follow exactly the same rules as local ones.
All game modes are playable and covered by automated tests on the rules and the server. It currently builds as an Android development build; ads and purchases are not connected yet.
highlights: Rules engine shared by client and server
Team, Chaos and Race rule variants for Ludo
Authoritative server over WebSockets
Automated tests for rules, server and Unity play
alt: Cover graphic: a Ludo board in four colours

name: Echo Rush
tagline: A colourful multiplayer party game.
desc: A colourful party game with 14 modes across 11 generated stages, with a PC host and phone clients playing together.
details: Echo Rush is a fast, colourful party game in the spirit of obstacle-course battle games: many short modes played across generated stages.
Version 0.2.0 is playable. A PC host with a phone client has been tested together over Wi-Fi.
highlights: 14 game modes
11 generated stage scenes
PC host and Android client tested over Wi-Fi
alt: Cover graphic: echo rings and a stage track

name: Shadow Shift
tagline: A one-tap game about flipping between light and shadow.
desc: A one-tap hopper: tap to flip between the light and shadow worlds and land only on solid shapes.
details: Shadow Shift is a minimal one-tap game. Each tap flips the world between light and shadow, and your character can only land on shapes that are solid in the current world.
Everything is made in code: sprites, icons and sound effects are generated, and a fairness solver checks every generated level. It has been tested on a Galaxy S21.
highlights: Every sprite and sound generated in code
Level generator checked by a fairness solver
Automated logic tests and on-device testing
alt: Shadow Shift menu, gameplay and campaign screens

tagline: A racing mode built on Unity's open Boat Attack sample.

details: This is an experiment on top of Unity's open-source Boat Attack project, adapted to build and run on Android. The base boats, water and tracks belong to Unity's sample; the gameplay and mobile build work are mine.

name: VPN Super Free

desc: One-tap VPN that picks the fastest server and only says “Protected” after traffic really flows. Split tunnelling, live exit-IP check, server switching without dropping.
alt: VPN Super home, protected and locations screens

name: Brushlark: AR Tracing Camera
tagline: Trace sketches onto real paper through your phone camera.
desc: Trace a sketch onto real paper through your phone camera, or draw on screen. 70 original sketches and 40 step-by-step drawing lessons.
details: Brushlark puts a sketch over the live camera view so you can trace it onto paper. You can move, scale, rotate, lock and fade the sketch, then draw it by hand. Or draw directly on screen with pencil, pen, brush and eraser, with undo, redo and PNG export.
A Drawing School adds 40 guided lessons that build each picture in stages. The app has been installed and checked on a Galaxy S21; store release and iOS are still to come.
highlights: 70 original sketches in 11 categories
40 step-by-step lessons
Tracing camera with lock, opacity, size and rotate
Remove-ads purchase and consent flow built in
alt: Brushlark home, tracing and sketch library screens

tagline: Paint and sculpt in virtual reality.
desc: Painting and sculpting in virtual reality with 10 brushes, a gallery you can walk through and a library of your creations.
details: VR Art Studio is a Quest creative tool: paint in the air with ten brushes, build sculptures from shapes and voxels, and show your work in themed galleries you can teleport around.
A development build runs through every screen in automated tests. Testing on a headset is the next milestone, so it is not released yet.

Three themed galleries with teleport
Automated UI and logic tests
